name: Basilicata
summary: A dark blue field with the regional arms: a white shield with four blue wavy lines for the region's four main rivers.
origin: The flag was adopted in 1999. An unofficial variant adds the words 'Regione Basilicata'.

symbols.name: Four waves
symbols.description: Four blue wavy lines on silver.
symbols.meaning: The rivers Basento, Agri, Bradano and Sinni.

facts: Matera's cave dwellings, the Sassi, are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
The region's older name is Lucania.
clues: A silver shield with four wavy blue lines on blue.
Its waves stand for four rivers.
The region of the Sassi of Matera.
